data_description.device_ip: IP address of the intercom on your LAN.
data_description.verify_ssl: Disable if the device uses a self-signed certificate.

data.enable_lan_rung: Detect rings via LAN broadcast (fast, needs phone on Wi-Fi)
data.enable_record_rung: Detect rings via the ring picture log (per-channel)

data_description.door_password: Unlock password for set.device.opendoor. Leave empty to use the device password (sent SHA-256 hashed).
data_description.default_door: Channel used by the Open door button and the service default. 1 = CAM1/DOOR1 (verified), 2 = CAM2/DOOR2, 0 = standalone outputs (gate).
data_description.default_lock: Lock id used by the Open door button and the service default. 1 = door (verified), 2 = automatic gate, 0 = default.
data_description.cameras: Camera entities from other integrations to associate with this intercom: they are shown on the device page (not restreamed).
data_description.enable_lan_rung: Listens for the Vidos app/door-station ASZENO discovery burst on UDP 5000/5001; fires the doorbell event within seconds of a ring. Turning it off falls back to status polling only.
data_description.enable_record_rung: Reads the device's picture-record log (get.record.session/message) to detect presses; the record's channel tells you which doorbell rang. Keep the LAN broadcast fallback enabled as well.
data_description.record_poll_interval: How often to query the ring picture log. Lower is faster, higher is gentler on the device (3-30 seconds).
data_description.channel_1_name: Name shown for rings on channel 1 (camera doorbell).
data_description.channel_2_name: Name shown for rings on channel 2 (dummy button).
data_description.enable_camera: Adds a camera entity that grabs a still image on demand from the intercom's QUII video port (no continuous streaming). Requires the HA ffmpeg binary.

open_door.name: Open door
open_door.description: Open a door on a Vidos X device.

door.name: Door (channel)
door.description: Channel the lock is attached to: 1 = CAM1/DOOR1, 2 = CAM2/DOOR2, 0 = standalone outputs (gate). Omit to use the configured default.

lock.name: Lock
lock.description: Lock id from get.device.attachInfo: 0 = default, 1 = door, 2 = automatic gate. Omit to use the configured default.
